lessons: CRITICAL (expert-found, pre-existing) FIXED: the skill routed export/international sales to a plain Receipt (type 400) and called export 'VAT-exempt' (vatType:1). For an osek murshe, export of services is ZERO-RATED (0%, VAT Law Sec 30), legally distinct from exempt (patur) and reported in different VAT-return boxes with opposite input-VAT consequences. Now: issue a tax invoice (305/320) with each income row at vatRate:0; use 400 only for a payment receipt. Fixed SKILL.md Key rule + income-row table + Workflow 4 JSON (now type 320, vatType:0, vatRate:0) + SKILL_HE mirrors.

FABRICATION FIXED: income-row vatType table claimed '1 = VAT included in price' and '2 = Exempt for line'. No such field/value exists. Canonical DocumentVatType enum (developers.morning.co) is 0=Default, 1=Exempt, 2=Mixed at BOTH document and row level; a specific rate is set via the separate vatRate field (decimal). Added developers.morning.co as the canonical Reference Links row (supersedes Apiary for enum meanings).
STALE fix: osek patur turnover ceiling was the 2025 round figure (120k); 2026 CPI-adjusted ceiling is 122,833 shekel. Re-verify yearly.

Removed a FALSE 'Apiary mirror retired / HTTP 502' claim (4 files). Apiary (greeninvoice.docs.apiary.io) is live and is the most detailed reference; the skill had been steering agents away from it. An inverse-fabrication: an invented deprecation.
Currency count corrected 28 -> 27 (the document-creatable currency enum has 27 entries on both Apiary and developers.morning.co).

VERIFIED unchanged and correct: host api.greeninvoice.co.il (no api.morning.co.il host), API-key->/account/token->JWT bearer (NOT OAuth2), decimal shekels (NOT agorot), 13 document types, SHAAM threshold NIS 5,000 from Jun 1 2026. The two historical fabrication traps (agorot, OAuth2) are absent.

CARRY (MAJOR): osek patur is told to use type 320 'Tax Invoice-Receipt'; for a patur Green Invoice renders it as חשבונית/קבלה (no מס) and a patur cannot issue 305 (already noted). Consider a per-business GET /documents/types note next cycle.
CARRY (verified, no change needed): credit notes (330) are EXCLUDED from the allocation-number requirement (only חשבונית מס + מס/קבלה above threshold need it) - the skill's silence on 330 is correct.
CARRY (MINOR): description says '8 payment types' while the enum table lists 9 rows (incl -1 Unpaid). Defensible (8 methods + Unpaid status) and left unchanged to avoid a description-eval cycle.

Evidence gate over-extracts on this API skill: verbed endpoint paths, example calc amounts, ILS code, AND its OWN optimization-log lessons (a shekel-amount mention written with the NIS prefix inside a lesson was extracted as a phantom claim - keep NIS-prefixed amounts out of log prose, write '120k' style instead). Documented under api-endpoints + internal-example-values + export-zero-rated entries.

SUPERSEDES THE 2026-06-28 CYCLE ON TWO POINTS. Do not revert these on the strength of that entry: (a) Apiary IS now retired. greeninvoice.docs.apiary.io returns HTTP 404 ('Apiary - Page not found'), confirmed in a browser 2026-07-27. It was genuinely live on 2026-06-28, so the previous cycle was right to call the earlier deprecation notice a fabrication. It has since actually died. The previous cycle's 'NOT OAuth2' finding was correct at the time and is now false.

CRITICAL script bug FIXED: create-document built the payment line as amount*quantity (the NET subtotal) while sending vatType 0, so the server added VAT on top. The documented headline example (--amount 5000 --type 320) recorded a 5,000 payment against a 5,900 document: the tax-invoice-receipt never closes and the bank reconciliation carries a permanent VAT-sized gap. Payment is now derived as gross, with --payment-amount for the vatType 2 (mixed) case where a single rate cannot derive it, and money moved to Decimal.

CRITICAL evidence bug FIXED: claim api-base-auth still asserted '(NOT OAuth2)' and was sourced to the now-dead Apiary URL, so the evidence file simultaneously ratified the old and new auth state. Four claims were re-sourced from Apiary to developers.morning.co. THIS IS THE THIRD TIME IN THIS BATCH that a corrected claim was added without retiring the superseded one; always grep evidence.json for the OLD value before adding the new one.

STALE FIXED: the allocation-number prose said the threshold 'is currently NIS 10,000 ... drops to 5,000 on Jun 1, 2026' in four places. As of 2026-07-27 the 5,000 figure has been in force for ~2 months. An agent following the old prose skips allocation numbers on invoices between 5,000 and 10,000, silently breaking the buyer's input-VAT deduction.
Document types corrected 13 -> 15: codes 20 (חשבון / אישור תשלום) and 410 (ביטול תרומה) were missing, verified against the live DocumentType enum.

Withholding workflow contradiction FIXED: references/document-workflows.md said cash received was 'NIS 8,000 + the NIS 2,000 withheld' four lines after correctly saying 9,800 remitted, and the JSON block sums 9,800+2,000=11,800. evidence.json had enshrined the wrong 8,000 figure.

COVERAGE: added Step 10.5 Suppliers and Expenses (POST /v1/suppliers, POST /v1/expenses), previously zero mentions across every file. Documented the trap that an expense created WITH a file becomes an unapproved DRAFT that is not counted until approved, which silently under-reports expenses and under-claims input VAT.
Added an osek zair clarification: it is an INCOME TAX status under Amendment 265, independent of the VAT classification, not a Green Invoice business type. Users increasingly self-describe this way.
Removed an unsourced invented figure: 'roughly 3 requests per second' for rate limiting, which the same sentence admitted was unpublished. Replaced with behaviour-based guidance.
